name: Ralli Wolf RW-RH-26 800W 26mm Professional SDS-Plus Rotary Hammer
shortDescription: Versatile 800W 26mm 3-mode SDS-Plus rotary hammer drill delivering 0-4000 BPM with mechanical safety clutch for heavy drilling and chiseling in concrete.
overview: The Ralli Wolf RW-RH-26 is a workhorse 26mm SDS-Plus rotary hammer engineered for electricians, plumbers, and structural contractors needing relentless penetration through reinforced concrete, stone, and brickwork. Powered by a high-torque 800W copper-wound motor delivering 0-1100 RPM and up to 4000 impacts per minute, it features three distinct modes: rotary drilling for steel and wood, hammer drilling for concrete, and rotation-stop chipping for channel chiseling. An integrated mechanical safety clutch disengages the drive train instantly if a bit binds in rebar, preventing dangerous wrist torque twist.
keyFeatures: High-torque 800W motor engineered for tough concrete anchor drilling
3-in-1 multi-mode selector: Rotary Drilling, Hammer Drilling, and Chiseling
SDS-Plus tool chuck allows fast bit insertion with automatic locking
Mechanical safety overload slip clutch protects user if drill bit binds
Variable speed trigger with forward / reverse toggle and lock-on button
Impact rate up to 4000 BPM delivers rapid hole penetration in hard aggregate
360-degree adjustable auxiliary handle with metal depth gauge rod
applications: Drilling anchor holes in concrete slabs, columns, and beams
Electrical conduit chases and switch box recessed holes
Plumbing core holes through brick and masonry walls
Light tile chiseling, wall spalling, and mortar cleaning
